values.note: Jackson County 2026 camping fees (non-county-resident rates as the base): modern site 30-amp $38, 50-amp $43; rustic (Swains Lake only) $30; cabin $55. Jackson County residents pay $5 less ($33 / $38 / $25 / $50). Dump station free to campers. 10-night maximum.

fees.source: https://www.co.jackson.mi.us/DocumentCenter/View/22677/Camping-Fees-2026-Season?bidId= ('Non-County Resident Modern Site (30 amp service) $38.00', '(50 amp service) $43.00'; county resident $33 / $38), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.co.jackson.mi.us/facilities/facility/details/swains-lake-county-park--campground-22 ('56 modern campsites are available with water and electricity'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations open January 2 each year, online (Jackson County WebTrac) or by phone at the parks office, (517) 788-4320. A new permit can be issued 24 hours after a 10-night stay ends.

booking.source: https://www.co.jackson.mi.us/facilities/facility/details/swains-lake-county-park--campground-22 ('Reservations open the 2nd of January. Online reservations can be made here: https://mijacksoncountyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/', 'Campers are not permitted to camp for more than 10 consecutive nights'), read 2026-10-22

note: Jackson County Parks & Rec campground on Swains Lake, a 26-acre park with shaded sites overlooking the lake, a boat launch, swimming area, nature trails and shore fishing for stocked trout; the Falling Waters Trail is nearby. --Claude
summary: Changed fees $33-43 -> $38-43: the base is now the non-county-resident rate (30-amp $38, 50-amp $43), with the $5 county-resident discount in fees.note. Confirmed 56 water/electric sites, WebTrac online booking (opens Jan 2), 10-night max. The county's fee sheet lists 30- and 50-amp sites for both its campgrounds, so amperage at Swains is left unknown; showers/dump left derived (park page says only 'Restrooms'). Season not stated. Phone 517-524-7666 matches the fee sheet's campground number (office 517-788-4320).
